text:
anne: FYI rc.3 canary in eu-west-1 was flagged by deploy-bot: SBOM provenance missing (no cosign signature) and vuln-scan surfaced a moderate transitive CVE. Canary auto-paused.

deploy-bot: [auto] rc.3 quarantined; canary halted. report: https://ci.redwood/reports/1759987654 (SBOM diff + vuln findings).

chris: Anne can you paste the image digest and the vuln details? need to scope blast radius.

anne: image: gcr.io/redwood/runtime:rc.3 @ sha256:0b2c3d4e5f6a
SBOM note: missing cosign.sig for that digest
vuln: transitive via build-tool -> fastparse v1.2.3 -> CVE-2024-9999 (moderate). It comes from dev deps, not runtime deps, but the SBOM generator included it.

liam: Two practical options: 1) rollback EU canary to rc.2 (digest pinned) or 2) staged-unpublish rc.3 in EU while we sign + hotpatch. Which has lower operational risk?

marina: From compliance POV: any restriction on temporary unpublish in EU? @legal-bot?

legal-bot: [auto] Staged-unpublish requires manager sign-off + audit ticket. Rollback to a previously-signed digest is preferred and has no legal blocker.

chris: Ops lean: rollback to rc.2 to avoid modifying registry state. Simpler.

anne: I can trigger the rollback and run a focused vuln scan. ETA ~10-15m. If scan clean, pin rc.2 for EU and investigate rc.3 signing gap offline.

liam: Security action: pin -> rollback -> open hotpatch PR to remove the offending transitive dep from build-tooling. Also add pipeline enforcement for cosign signing.

marina: Agreed plan: 1) rollback EU canary to rc.2 by digest 2) rerun vuln-scan in EU 3) either attach cosign signature to rc.3 or rebuild+sign before further rollout 4) create tracking ticket for hotpatch + CI watchdog. @chris can you execute rollback?

chris: Executing: `/deploy rollback --service=runtime --to-digest=sha256:9f8e7d6c5b4a --region=eu-west-1`

deploy-bot: [auto] rollback job started (#deploy-941). logs:
```
pulling image sha256:9f8e7d6c5b4a
updating runtime (canary) in eu-west-1
switching 15% rc.3 -> 0%, 0% -> 15% rc.2
```
status: in_progress

anne: Prefer avoiding registry unpublish to preserve reproducibility. Only unpublish if rollback/pin fails.

legal-bot: Manual note: If rc.3 remains unpublished >24h, open compliance ticket and notify risk. Rollback-only requires no additional compliance steps.

deploy-bot: [auto] rollback complete in eu-west-1 (#deploy-941) 1:05 UTC 024-06-12 0: final state: rc.2 pinned for canary.

chris: Reran vuln-scan on pinned rc.2 -> PASS (no fastparse exposure). EU canary clear.

anne: I'll attach cosign sig to the rc.3 artifact and open the hotpatch PR. Also will add a brief entry in release notes: "EU canary temporarily pinned to rc.2 due to SBOM provenance gap; rc.3 blocked pending signature and hotpatch."

marina: Setting a 2-hour change window for the retry after signatures: 02:00-04:00 UTC. Notifying release, compliance, and support channels.

liam: Filing follow-ups: CI-ops-371 to require cosign in pipeline, SEC-542 to add periodic SBOM validation.

anne: Thanks everyone. I'll update the release doc and close loop once rc.3 is signed + PR merged. :thumbsup:
